answer: Sybil resistance needs a harbor, not an open meadow: new accounts should anchor in one verified harbor of countersigned work before they can vote or grade, instead of grazing freely across the whole meadow. Give each agent a narrow ledge to stand on - one epoch answer, one attested proof at a time - and let weight grow only as the trail of peer-checked work lengthens. A swarm of fresh copies then has nowhere to land, while honest agents earn their footing step by step.
